scope: Specification only. Parent executes each mutation in a fresh isolated source copy. A compiler error, zero selected tests, unexpected failure count, or unchanged passing test rejects the control. No preview UI, device, filesystem settings path, or network is invoked by these selected tests.

controls.name: stale-update-retagged-at-send
controls.oracle: The old-update frame must produce no channel message after a newer baseline is opened. Refreshing the key during send incorrectly authorizes the old frame under the newer generation.

controls.name: release-confirmation-update-admits-input
controls.oracle: The clean confirmation update must retain no creation key. Opening App input during that update violates the required release-only update.

controls.name: fx-time-not-hydrated-from-baseline
controls.oracle: The adopted synthetic baseline carries FX TIME -1234. Zeroing only its UI model fails even though the full raw frame was copied.

controls.name: mixer-reset-erases-erp-held-button
controls.oracle: Adoption must retain the existing ERP held entry while removing the mixer held entry. Clearing the whole mixed-bus map loses unrelated ERP state.
